result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `ScopingConventions.java`, and the tests pass.

Changes in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:
- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the path pattern was `(html|html|xhtml)`, a typo for `htm`. It is now `(html|htm|xhtml)` on all three rules.
- **.NET documentation XML:** `.*/[.]xml` became `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **JavaScript `// Generated by …`:** `.*/[.]js` became `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle build scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` became `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. `build.gradle` still matches its existing rule.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It covers the positive cases (`.htm` pkgdown/Doxygen/meta pages, `.html` Doxygen, `.xhtml` meta, `<doc>` XML, `// Generated by` JS, `build-gradle.js`, `build.gradle`) and the negative cases (plain `.htm`, `config/settings.xml`, plain `app.js`, `src/app.js` in build scope). It passes, along with `SourceFileFilterTest` and `CodeConfigurationTest`.

Nothing is committed.
